info.name: 03 - Repository API V2 Recipes
info.description: Scaffold for the five guided workflows.

item.name: 01 - Find a document by metadata
item.description: Search a folder by field value and read fields on the matching entry.

item.name: 02 - Read a search across multiple pages
item.description: Follow continuation until exhausted or a maximum is reached.

item.name: 03 - Upload a PDF and apply metadata
item.description: Create a child folder in a test location, upload the sample, apply metadata, and verify it.

item.name: 04 - Update single-value and multivalue fields
item.description: Read, update, and verify the fields on a disposable document.

item.name: 05 - Export a document and download the result
item.description: Request export, follow any long operation, and save the file locally.
